14.name: Kelly Clarkson
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Trump banning the press from the White House and his plan to build a triumphal arch in Washington filled with drones and snipers before speaking with Kelly Clarkson.

14.name: Jon Hamm, Sabrina Impacciatore, Taylor Tomlinson
14.overview: Seth does his monologue before teaming up with Amber Ruffin and Jenny Hagel to read jokes that just sound wrong coming from him, then speaks with guests Jon Hamm, Sabrina Impacciatore and Taylor Tomlinson.

14.name: Ethan Hawke, Zara Larsson
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Republicans breaking with Trump over his state dinner with Chinese President Xi Jinping as Trump's poll numbers continue to sink to all-time lows, before speaking with Ethan Hawke and Zara Larsson.

14.name: Kenan Thompson, Sandra Hüller
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Trump hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping for a controversial state dinner as Republicans try to distance themselves from him before speaking with guests Kenan Thompson and Sandra Hüller.

14.name: Kate McKinnon, Christopher Abbott
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Donald Trump saying he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as Republicans openly broke with him and called for an end to the war, then speaks with guests Kate McKinnon and Christopher Abbott.

14.name: Rachel Maddow, Eric Idle, Danny Meyer
14.overview: Seth addresses President Trump reportedly telling congressional leaders that he was canceling nearly a billion dollars in federal funding and more in his monologue for Tuesday, September 29, before former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt and Vice President JD Vance hold an impromptu press briefing to answer burning questions; then, Seth speaks with guests Rachel Maddow, Eric Idle and Danny Meyer.

14.name: Florence Pugh, Ms. Pat
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Senate Republicans humiliating themselves in a train wreck hearing where they tried and failed to catch former special prosecutor Jack Smith in a gotcha moment, then speaks with guests Florence Pugh and Ms. Pat.

14.name: Dakota Johnson, Mike Tomlin
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Donald Trump facing backlash from his own party for using taxpayer dollars to air campaign ads and his handpicked candidate for Senate in Texas bashing him, then speaks with guests Dakota Johnson and Mike Tomlin.

14.name: Jessica Biel, Slayyyter
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Trump doxxing one Republican candidate and calling another "controversial" while hitting the campaign trail amid midterm election panic, then speaks with guests Jessica Biel and Slayyyter.

14.name: Sebastian Stan, Jane Wickline, George Saunders
14.overview: Seth addresses President Trump claiming that gas prices are high because of "blue states, like California" and more in his monologue for Tuesday, October 6, before checking in with his monologue writers, holding a surprise inspection to review the quality of their jokes and speaking with guests Sebastian Stan, Jane Wickline and George Saunders.

14.name: Ben Affleck, David Byrne
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Trump suggesting Iran could "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego as his allies are plotting ways to undermine the midterms, then speaks with guests Ben Affleck and David Byrne.

14.name: James McAvoy, Chef José Andrés
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Trump making life more difficult for Republicans in the midterms as he hits the campaign trail in deep red states before speaking with guests James McAvoy and Chef José Andrés.

14.name: Jenna Ortega, Ina Garten
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at Donald Trump's approval rating hitting a new all-time low just two weeks ahead of the midterms, then speaks with guests Jenna Ortega and Ina Garten.

14.name: Quinta Brunson, Stephen Graham, Owen Thiele
14.overview: Seth addresses President Trump praising Elon Musk and more in his monologue for Tuesday, October 20, before Late Night writer Amber Ruffin recaps what's happening in pop culture news; then, Seth speaks with guests Quinta Brunson, Stephen Graham and Owen Thiele.

14.name: Liam Neeson, Rachel Kaly
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at JD Vance hitting the campaign trail despite record-low approval ratings and only making things worse for Republicans, then speaks with guests Liam Neeson and Rachel Kaly.

14.name: Helen Mirren, John Turturro
14.overview: Seth takes a closer look at widespread bipartisan outrage over a despicable GOP ad in Ohio and Donald Trump's new argument for why people should vote GOP, then speaks with guests Helen Mirren and John Turturro.

overview: ست مایرز، که با سابقه‌ترین مجری «پخش زنده شنبه شب» در نمایش بسیار محبوب «به‌روز‌رسانی آخر هفته» است، مجری‌گری برنامه «آخر شب» اِن‌بی‌سی را به عهده می‌گیرد، ماوایی برای مهمانان مشهور برگزیده، نمایش‌های شاد به‌یادماندنی و بهترین استعدادهای موسیقی. مایرز به‌عنوان نویسنده اصلی برنده جایزه امی برای پخش زنده شنبه شب «SNL»، به‌خاطر بذله‌گوهای تند و تیز و نمایش‌های طنز کاملاً به‌موقع صاحب نام است و به‌خاطر شوخی‌ها و طنزهای خود شهرت پیدا کرده است. با رفتن جیمی فالون به "برنامه امشب"، مایرز تغییر روندش را از «شنبه شب زنده» به سمت جدیدش در «آخر شب» در دست می‌گیرد.
tagline: One man dares to take a closer look.
title: Late Night with Seth Meyers
